text:
sara-partnerships: Heads-up 1: Customer PO 913452 arrived but the marketplace portal returned a validation error: accept_window/ack timestamp mismatch. Need quick unblock.

nick-ops: Can you paste the portal error blob?

sara-partnerships: vendor-portal response: `status=422, error=accept_window_mismatch, details=ack_ts 2026-03-02T02:15:00 (customer local) not in vendor_window [2026-03-02T08:00:00,2026-03-03T08:00:00]`

jeff-sales: Customer submitted in PST; partner procurement is CET. Looks like timezone normalization bug. Customer on a tight schedule (launch tomorrow).

maria-legal: Any contract changes required? Or is this purely portal validation?

sara-partnerships: No redlines. Pure validation. Partner portal expects ack_ts in UTC and their UI sent local time.

vendor-portal-bot: Ticket VP-4521 created for PO 913452 ingestion failure.

nick-ops: Short-term options: 1) Ask customer to reissue PO with explicit Z (UTC) on the ack_ts, 2) ask partner to relax accept_window to accept the local time variant temporarily. Which has faster runway?

jeff-sales: Customer cannot re-sign today. Partner can toggle a config but requires ops deploy. I'll ask them now.

maria-legal: If partner toggles, make sure note in contract tracker that this is an ingestion-only relaxation and doesn't change effective dates. I'll prepare a one-liner approval email.

sara-partnerships: Partner ops responded: they can enable "accept_window_loose_mode" for our account. Estimated 4 hours to push to prod.

nick-ops: Infra is OK with ingestion-only relax. We keep original timestamps in logs and flag for audit. No backend side effects.

deploy-bot: Started deploy for partner-config/accept_window_loose_mode (deploy-4991). ETA ~2h to staging then 2-3h to prod.

sara-partnerships: Re-ingest blocked until staging toggle is up. Holding payload.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy complete (deploy-4991). Partner confirmed staging accepted PO when re-sent.

sara-partnerships: Re-sent PO to staging, accepted. Partner scheduling prod deploy in ~2h.

deploy-bot: Production deploy finished (deploy-4997).

sara-partnerships: Confirmed portal accepted PO 913452 in prod. Customer notified and cleared for launch. Closing escalation.

maria-legal: Logged the temporary config change in the contract tracker and added the one-line approval.

jeff-sales: Thanks all. Please file a follow-up engineering ticket to normalize timezone parsing in the portal and add clearer UX copy to the partner UI.

sara-partnerships: Will open INT-5785 for engineering with repro steps and suggested UX copy. Also posting a short recap in partnerships channel. :thumbsup:
